products.name: HephaestusEngine
products.description: A high-performance, Vulkan-based game engine with integrated editor and development tools. Includes runtime assets, shaders, and editor configuration for cross-platform game development.

products.name: AtlasCore
products.description: Atlas Core is a secure, user-friendly desktop application that centralizes downloads, documentation, and SDK distribution. It streamlines one-click updates, versioned asset delivery, and access to project resources so teams and users stay up to date with minimal effort.
